mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dataset WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0 FOR UPDATEFOR SHARE

SELECT d.* FROM public.nocode_report_dataset d WHERE d.deleted=0 AND AND d.name ILIKE #{search} ESCAPE '!'
AND d.folder_id IS NULL AND d.folder_id IN ( WITH RECURSIVE branch AS ( SELECT id FROM public.nocode_report_folder WHERE id=#{folder} AND resource_kind='DATASET' AND deleted=0 UNION SELECT f.id FROM public.nocode_report_folder f JOIN branch b ON f.parent_id=b.id WHERE f.deleted=0 AND f.resource_kind='DATASET' ) SELECT id FROM branch )
ORDER BY d.update_time DESC,d.id DESC
mapper.sql: (d.owner_id=#{actor} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.nocode_report_resource_acl acl, LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(acl.policy_json) member WHERE acl.resource_kind='DATASET' AND acl.resource_id=d.id AND acl.deleted=0 AND (member->'actions') @> '["VIEW_META"]'::jsonb AND (member->>'principalKind') || ':' || (member->>'principalId') IN #{principal} ))
mapper.select: SELECT id,name,status,draft_json FROM public.nocode_report_dataset WHERE deleted=0 AND name ILIKE #{search} ESCAPE '!' ORDER BY update_time DESC,id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_dataset SET name=#{row.name},description=#{row.description},draft_json=CAST(#{row.draftJson} AS jsonb), draft_checksum=#{row.draftChecksum},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{row.id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0
UPDATE public.nocode_report_dataset SET folder_id=#{folder},lock_version=lock_version+1, updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0

UPDATE public.nocode_report_dataset SET published_version=#{number},status=CASE WHEN published_version IS NULL THEN 'ACTIVE' ELSE status END, lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
UPDATE public.nocode_report_dataset SET status=#{status},lock_version=lock_version+1,updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND version_no=#{number} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND creator=#{actor} AND request_id=#{request} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_report_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM public.nocode_report_dependency WHERE target_kind='DATASET' AND target_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
SELECT version_no FROM public.nocode_report_dataset_version WHERE dataset_id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_report_dataset SET deleted=1,status='INACTIVE',lock_version=lock_version+1, updater=#{actor},update_time=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{id} AND lock_version=#{expected} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_report_operation_log(resource_kind,resource_id,action,revision,before_json,after_json,reason,creator,updater) VALUES(#{row.resourceKind},#{row.resourceId},#{row.action},#{row.revision},CAST(#{row.beforeJson} AS jsonb),CAST(#{row.afterJson} AS jsonb),#{row.reason},#{actor},#{actor})
